name: Update all packages
description: Prints what would be upgraded, then upgrades it. Works on apt, dnf, apk and pacman.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Update all packages
snippets.description: The upgrade list comes first, so nothing changes before you have seen it.

steps.content:
# The upgrade list is printed first so you can stop before it runs if something
# on it surprises you.
echo "== What would change =="
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if sudo apt-get update >/dev/null; then
    OUT=$(apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2)
    if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "$OUT"; else echo "up to date — nothing to upgrade"; fi
  else
    echo "(could not refresh the package index — skipping the preview)"
  fi
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf check-update || true
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if sudo apk update >/dev/null; then
    OUT=$(apk list --upgradable 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "$OUT"; else echo "up to date — nothing to upgrade"; fi
  else
    echo "(could not refresh the package index — skipping the preview)"
  fi
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if pacman -Sy >/dev/null; then
    OUT=$(pacman -Qu)
    if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then echo "$OUT"; else echo "up to date — nothing to upgrade"; fi
  else
    echo "(could not refresh the package index — skipping the preview)"
  fi
else
  echo "no supported package manager found"
fi

echo
echo "== Upgrading =="
if   command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get upgrade -y
elif command -v dnf     >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf upgrade -y
elif command -v apk     >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apk upgrade
elif command -v pacman  >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -Su --noconfirm
fi

echo
echo "== Done =="
